_comment: Launch this job on a schedule (e.g. every 2 minutes) rather than calling it once with an in-step retry loop -- see docs/drasi-integration.md. Each launch does exactly one status check.

Data.executionId: <supplied via job-launch input: the executionId captured from export-start>

steps._comment: D365 statuses NotRun/Failed both fail this step's output_schema and therefore this job run -- that IS the intended behavior, not a bug. NotRun means 'not ready yet, the next scheduled tick will check again.' Failed means the export genuinely failed and needs operator attention; distinguish the two by inspecting the schema-validation error text or the raw response logged for this step, since both currently surface as the same SchemaValidation error class.
